result.instructions: Tools for GoAffPro, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which affiliates are waiting for approval in my GoAffPro program?"; "Show the orders and commission of my top affiliate this month."; "How much do I owe each affiliate right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GoAffPro data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run goaffpro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run goaffpro_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run goaffpro_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. goaffpro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_affiliates
tools.title: List affiliates
tools.description: List the affiliates of the program with status, ref code, coupon, group and contact fields. GET /admin/affiliates. Answer: { affiliates: [] }.

ref_code.description: Only the affiliate with this ref code.

email.description: Only the affiliate with this email.

coupon.description: Only the affiliate that owns this coupon code.

status.description: Comma-separated statuses: pending, approved, invited, rejected.

since_id.description: Only items with an id greater than this id (paging by id).

created_at_min.description: Only items created at or after this date. Use a date such as 2026-10-01 or 'Sun Jul 26 2019 12:10:07 GMT+0530'.

created_at_max.description: Only items created at or before this date. Use a date such as 2026-10-01 or 'Sun Jul 26 2019 12:10:07 GMT+0530'.

updated_at_min.description: Only affiliates updated at or after this date.

updated_at_max.description: Only affiliates updated at or before this date.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for paging).

tools.name: goaffpro_set_affiliate_status
tools.title: Set affiliate status
tools.description: WRITE: approve, reject or set to pending one affiliate. The affiliate may get an email from GoAffPro. PATCH /admin/affiliates/{id}.

tools.name: goaffpro_add_affiliate_coupon
tools.title: Add a coupon to an affiliate
tools.description: WRITE: add a discount coupon code to one affiliate. This changes the store discounts. A repeat call can create a second coupon. POST /admin/affiliates/{id}/coupons.

code.description: The coupon code, for example JOHN10OFF.

discount_value.description: The discount amount or percent (not needed for free_shipping).

annotations.title: Add a coupon to an affiliate
